import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Router with ordered first-match rules.
    Rules are evaluated in order; a row goes to the FIRST matching port only.
    Unmatched rows go to the default port.
    """
    claims = inputs["claims"].copy()
    
    # Initialize matched tracking as a boolean Series
    matched = pd.Series([False] * len(claims), index=claims.index)
    
    # Initialize output lists
    claims_fast_track = []
    claims_high_value = []
    claims_manual_review = []
    
    # Rule 1: amount <= 500 and photos_attached == 1 → fast_track
    mask1 = (claims["amount"] <= 500) & (claims["photos_attached"] == 1) & ~matched
    claims_fast_track.append(claims[mask1])
    matched = matched | mask1
    
    # Rule 2: amount > 10000 → high_value
    mask2 = (claims["amount"] > 10000) & ~matched
    claims_high_value.append(claims[mask2])
    matched = matched | mask2
    
    # Rule 3: photos_attached == 0 or amount > 500 → manual_review
    mask3 = ((claims["photos_attached"] == 0) | (claims["amount"] > 500)) & ~matched
    claims_manual_review.append(claims[mask3])
    matched = matched | mask3
    
    # Concatenate results
    result_fast_track = pd.concat(claims_fast_track, ignore_index=True) if claims_fast_track else pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    result_high_value = pd.concat(claims_high_value, ignore_index=True) if claims_high_value else pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    result_manual_review = pd.concat(claims_manual_review, ignore_index=True) if claims_manual_review else pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    
    # Ensure empty dataframes have correct structure and column order
    if result_fast_track.empty:
        result_fast_track = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    else:
        result_fast_track = result_fast_track[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]
    
    if result_high_value.empty:
        result_high_value = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    else:
        result_high_value = result_high_value[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]
    
    if result_manual_review.empty:
        result_manual_review = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    else:
        result_manual_review = result_manual_review[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]
    
    return {
        "claims_fast_track": result_fast_track,
        "claims_high_value": result_high_value,
        "claims_manual_review": result_manual_review
    }
